plainLanguage: Round Rock has zoning, but this record could not be checked against the city's code in this research pass, so treat every number as a placeholder. Most new homes are in planned developments (PUDs) or HOA subdivisions whose plat and deed rules control setbacks and materials. Typical single-family lots are around 6,500 sq ft with about 25 ft front and 5 ft side setbacks. The city likely uses the 2021 building codes and climate zone 2A energy rules. Expect water and wastewater impact fees and an engineered foundation on clay soils. Check with Round Rock Planning & Development Services before final design.
